title: Preparing Single-Cell Suspension from Human Embryo/Fetus
author: Sten Linnarsson
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xmbfk2n

steps.title: Oxygenate EBSS
steps.instruction: Oxygenate Earl's Balanced Salt Solution (EBSS) by bubbling with 95% O2: 5% CO2 on ice for 5-10 min until the appropriate pH is reached.

steps.title: Prepare Enzyme Solutions
steps.instruction: Prepare the dissociation enzymes based on the tissue type.

substeps.instruction: For general tissue: Add 5 mL EBSS to Papain vial and dissolve at 37 °C, then move to room temperature (RT).
For embryonic/foetal heart: Use 5 mL of collagenase II at a concentration of 200 U/mL instead of Papain.
Add 500 μL EBSS to DNase vial and keep at RT.
Once dissolved, add 250 μL DNase to the Papain (or collagenase) vial.

steps.title: Prepare Equipment
steps.instruction: Pre-cool the centrifuge to 4-8 °C while enzymes are dissolving. Take images of the tissue and prepare dissection instruments.

steps.title: Process Tissue
steps.instruction: Cut the tissue into smaller pieces and transfer them to the enzyme vial using tweezers.

steps.title: Incubate Tissue
steps.instruction: Incubate the tissue at 37 °C. Duration depends on tissue type and age.

substeps.instruction: General tissue: Incubate for 25-40 min (younger tissue may require less time).
Embryonic/foetal heart: Incubate for 40 min - 1 h or more.

steps.title: Triturate Tissue
steps.instruction: Carefully triturate the tissue using a fire polished Pasteur pipette until pieces fall apart.

substeps.instruction: If undissociated pieces remain, continue incubation for 2-5 min more and triturate again.

steps.title: Filter and Centrifuge Cells
steps.instruction: Filter the dissociated cells through an EBSS-equilibrated cell strainer or Partec filter, then spin at 200 g for 5 min at 4-8 °C.

steps.title: Optional Gradient Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Perform gradient centrifugation if needed (e.g., to remove blood cells from heart suspensions).

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 900 μL EBSS, 100 μL Albumin inhibitor, and 50 μL DNase.
Carefully layer the suspension on top of 3 mL Albumin inhibitor solution.
Centrifuge at 70 g for 6 min at 4-8 °C with slow acceleration and deceleration.

steps.title: Resuspend and Count Cells
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in approximately 100 μL (or more if too concentrated) using a fire polished Pasteur pipette.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the cell suspension to a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube pre-coated with 30% bovine serum albumin (BSA).
Count the cells using a hemocytometer or an automated cell counter.
Adjust the concentration as desired for the 10X Chromium platform.
